title: Chapter 30: The Clown, Natsuki Subaru
content:
Chapter 30:

The Clown, Natsuki Subaru

There were broadly two hurdles Subaru must overcome to break through his one week at Roswaal Manor.

One was to win the trust of the people related to the mansion. This applied not only to Ram and Rem, but also included the master, Roswaal.

If he did not meet with their and his approval, there was a very high possibility that Subaru’s life would be erased under the pretext of silencing him.

This was the conclusion he had reached after thinking it over and over again with time to spare during his previous loops.

Similarly, going out without their permission would also fall under that category. Suspicious behavior lead to an immediate 

DEAD END

. It was one of the points where paying the utmost caution was appropriate.

And the second hurdle—for this one, he hasn’t even seen a clue yet.

Put bluntly, it was the true identity of the curse arts user attacking Roswaal Manor.

The user of the curse who took Subaru’s life the first time, caused Subaru to lose his mind and body the second time, and killed Rem in the fourth world.

Having reached the fifth world, searching for and defeating this opponent of whom he has not yet seen even a glimpse of their true identity—that was his greatest objective this time.

In summary, if he could vaguely win the trust of Ram and Rem, and on top of that defeat the evil magician, he could aim to break through the loop.

It was a situation where he had finally seen the victory conditions after dying four times.

To make matters worse, regarding the most important part of achieving those conditions, there were still many unknown factors, and he couldn’t deny the feeling that he has returned with zero plans.

It was at a level where he would sigh anew at his own difficult path ahead, but Subaru shook the head he wanted to clutch and looked forward.

No matter how high the wall standing in his way, he couldn’t just not challenge it.

He had returned, even taking the measure of killing himself. He had returned here, staking it on conditions that he didn’t even know if he could return under.

He had gone and died by his own hand once.

In that case, he should challenge it with the resolve of a dead man.

—That was what Subaru had decided.

※※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

“A~and so, Ram? From what you’ve seen, what is your evaluation of him?”

At the hour when the moon hung in the night sky, in the office on the top floor of Roswaal Manor, that secret conversation was taking place.

There were two participants. The master of the mansion and the room, Roswaal, and facing him was the pink-haired maid—Ram.

At Roswaal’s question, as he laced his fingers on the desk and broke into a smile, Ram tilted her head slightly in thought.

At her attitude of hesitating to report, Roswaal raised one eyebrow as if he had seen something rare,

“Huu~m, for Ram, who tends to make snap decisions about pretty much a~anything, to be conflicted is quite a rare thi~ing, isn’t i~it? Were you unable to gauge him in just one da~ay?”

“That is not the case, however.”

Words of denial returned immediately, but their content was still somewhat lacking in clarity. Touching her finger to her lips, leaving just a bit of bewilderment, she said,

“He—Barusu is, well, completely useless in terms of ability. His work as a servant is barely a step above an amateur’s. Before even considering whether he is suited for it or not, he is outside the scope of evaluation.”

“Hm~m, even though he asked to be allowed to wo~ork himself, that too is quite the mystery~y.”

Recalling the events at the breakfast table, Roswaal chuckled.

He remembered inviting the awakened guest to the dining table and discussing his deeds and their reward.

In Roswaal’s impression, he had placed the judgment that the boy was “someone who had received a fair amount of education, had a mind that worked well enough, and could protect himself decently.” It was not a bad evaluation, which also meant that in another sense, he was worthy of caution.

Therefore, he had ordered Ram, who was assigned to him as an instructor, under the pretext of surveillance, and was actually setting up this time for a report.

He didn’t think there would be results from the first day, but conversely, a character that could cause this kind of discrepancy in Ram’s attitude was a grave opponent.

“It is a mystery, however…”

“Yes, let’s hear it. Go ahead and tell me anything.”

“He is completely lacking in ability, but Barusu is… well, perhaps you could say he is positive to a disgusting degree.”

Roswaal furrowed his brows at Ram’s remark, which seemed more like she was searching for words rather than choosing them.

Ram herself, as she spoke, likely knew that it missed the point. With a look of frustration at not being able to find the exact words,

“He kept talking endlessly in that tone, and even when he messed up at times, he never stopped smiling; on the contrary, he ended up acting terribly devoted to us…”

“…What do~o you thi~ink?”

“Ram feels his demeanor is different from what she heard from Lady Emilia.”

To the low question, Ram responded with only that.

Roswaal, whose contact with him was brief, could not sense the points of doubt she held. However, it was the opinion of the sisters who had accumulated a fair amount of experience in the mansion. Considering his trust in them, her advice was a matter he should be sufficiently aware of.

“At any rate, it can’t be helped that his true character is invisible on the first day. We owe him a debt of gratitude for saving Lady Emilia. —Let’s take our ti~ime and observe how things progre~ess for a little while lo~onger, shall we~e?”

“…In the event of an emergency.”

It clearly conveyed that she did not want to hear what came next.

Even though her expression hadn’t changed, the fact that he could sense that was perhaps due to the length of their relationship. Gazing at such weakness in Ram with his yellow eye, Roswaal gave a small shake of his head side to side,

“The~en it sha~all be. I would like to handle it as peacefully as possible. —Please be careful that Rem doesn’t get ahead of herself.”

At times, that blue-haired girl had a tendency to act on her own judgment after grasping his intentions. Although she generally did not deviate from Roswaal’s judgments and guidelines, there were times he had trouble with her snap decisions that nipped the buds of possibility in the bud.

This time in particular, there was a possibility that her snap decision could head in a bad direction.

‘Rem has eliminated the danger beforehand. However, our relationship with Emilia has deteriorated.’

 That would be no laughing matter. It would be extremely troubling.

Because to Roswaal, those three were absolutely necessary pieces.

“By the way, Ram. Is the report finished?”

“…Yes. Ram apologizes for being unable to report anything of substance.”

“I wouldn’t blame you for so~omething like that. More importantly, shall we finish tonight’s duties? —It has been two nights. It must have been aching quite a bit, right?”

At Roswaal inviting her with a movement of his fingers, Ram obeyed with a somewhat enraptured look. She, who had been standing in front of the desk, approached him with a wavering step, and timidly placed her hips on the lap of the seated man,

“Tonight as well, Ram… excuses herself.”

“It’s the exercise of a natural right. It’s the usual, so there’s no~o need to be shy. It’s a precious body. Because it’s not yours alo~one.”

Tracing her cheek with his hand, he made Ram’s faintly closed face turn upwards. While combing her pink hair with his other hand, Roswaal closed one eye, and looking down at Ram with his blue eye,

“No~ow then, what kind of existence are you to u~us. I certainly hope we can proceed amicably, ri~ight?”

Muttering only inside his mouth, Roswaal switched his consciousness at that point.

Staring only at Ram in front of him, he sank his consciousness solely into Ram.

The night of the first day grew late.

—Closing with a bewitching secret conversation between the master of the mansion and the maid.

※※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

“Good morning! Clear skies today, perfect for laundry! Good for me, good for you, good for everyone! Good smile!”

Welcoming the morning of the second day, while greeting the rising morning sun with three cheers of banzai, Subaru was raising a loud cheer.

Standing in the middle of the yard, eyelids burned by the sunlight, he shook off his sleepy eyes by moving his body fully open.

First thing in the morning radio calisthenics, blood flowing firmly to his limbs, distributing the energy stored from sleeping throughout his entire body.

Finally stretching both hands to the heavens and shouting “Victory!” the beginning of the beginning of the day was over.

Sweating lightly on his forehead, Subaru refreshedly wiped it off and turned around.

Then,

“You’re truly energetic right from the morning…”

“Energetic as can be, super energetic! My energy is everyone’s courage, I love, you love, we love! Let’s get fired up!”

At the edge of the yard, in the shade of the garden surrounded by trees, Emilia, who had been doing her morning routine, smiled wryly. Hovering near her hands was a gray furball—meaning Puck—who was scrubbing his black eyes vigorously with his small hands.

“Seeing you wash your face like that, you’re a literal cat. Setting that aside, do spirits get sleepy too? Do you ever oversleep?”

“You guys get sleepy when fatigue builds up too, right? For spirits, when our reserves of mana, which is the source of our vitality, decrease, well, it becomes a similar thing. If we don’t have enough mana stored, the sleepiness continues like this… munyaa.”

Drawn by Puck yawning, Emilia also placed a palm over her lips and let out a small yawn. At their gestures, Subaru shrugged his shoulders and played the fool,

“It’s not good for the two of you to be night owls. It’s that, isn’t it? The type where you stayed up late into the night getting excited talking about the boys you like? Good, good, let me join in too! The girl I like? Let’s see, umm, it’s super embarrassing, but—”

Crossing his arms and casting his eyes down, Subaru sneaked peeks at Emilia. At Subaru’s attitude, Emilia casually waved her hand saying, “Yes, yes,”

“The one I like is Puck, and the one Puck likes is me. End of discussion.”

“Mutual love?! Is there room for me to cut in?! Is there?!”

“Nyo way. Lia is head over heels for my charm. Subaru, you might not have been a bad guy, but compared to me, you’re nothing. Just give up on this girl honestly and… nyau nyau!”

Puck had patronizingly fended off the pressing Subaru.

Subaru, from wherever he took it out, was biting into a hand 

towel

1

 and wailing “Kiiih!” while Puck was leaning back and preening his whiskers; Emilia pinched the ears of both without holding back,

“Both of you, stop taking it too far! If you keep saying things like that, I’m going to get mad.”

““Ouch ouch, she’s mad, she’s mad.””

The one person and one animal were awestruck in unison by Emilia’s punishment.

To the two who rubbed their respective affected areas after having their ears released, Emilia let out a small sigh,

“It’s good that you get along, but don’t use people as an excuse to play around. Reply if you understand. Yes?”

““Yeees.””

Prompted by her reaching out her hand, they found themselves nodding from the momentum.

He couldn’t shake the feeling of being completely led by the nose, but looking at her smiling in satisfaction, it was a wonder how such trivial matters ceased to matter.

A smile gently surfacing out of a sense of relief. Gaining that sensation of his lips loosening, Subaru inwardly panicked faintly and forced a smile,

“What’s this heart-pounding. Acting like an older sister to me who has the older-sister attribute, the appeal rush from Emilia-tan is too intense, I’m troubled + screaming in joy.”

“Screaming even though you’re joyful… What does that sound like?”

“Kyahiiin! Or something like this, maybe?”

Putting both fists near his chin, he did a small jump while bending one leg. It was a gesture that a cutesy character in an old manga might do, but he was surprised himself at the unexpectedly high accuracy of his imitation.

“I wonder why. I feel reaaally let down.”

“Unexpectedly unpopular! Why?! Do the world and I miss each other even in places like this, whyy?!”

To Emilia’s action of dropping her shoulders, Subaru gave an all-out reaction. The classic manga pose was something called ‘Sheeeh,’ but there was no particular reaction from her to this.

Ending in a misfire, his strength drained limply and he collapsed on the spot,

“It seems physical gags misfire a lot…! I can understand ‘Life’ and 

‘Flame’

2

 not conveying the image, but for devilish poses that charmed everyone from kids to adults not to be a hit, just how tough is this crowd…!”

“I don’t know what kind of wall you crashed into, but this is perfect. Look, Subaru. Come here, come sit here.”

To Subaru, who was resting his hands on the ground and looked ready to shed tears, Emilia lightly patted the spot next to her while sitting sideways on the grass.

The moment he realized it meant ‘come here,’ Subaru’s actions were fast. He practically bounded over, sliding into the spot next to her,

“Called upon, popped out, slid in, and I have arrived. What is it, what is it? What kind of perfect timing? Natsuki Subaru, the man who can reach the itchy spots, will scratch that spot on Emilia-tan’s back that’s itchy but out of reach exactly as ordered! I won’t do anything more than that!”

“I only invited you to come next to me, but the reaction was more than I expected; what should I do.”

“…”

Faced with such fierce momentum, even Emilia smiled wryly. On her palm, Puck touched his whiskers, remaining silent.

Perhaps judging from that posture that Puck could not be relied upon, Emilia prefaced with “Umm” and turned back to Subaru,

“So, how was yesterday? Were you able to do your work properly?”

“Yeah, it was eighty percent a failure!”

“I see. With so much confidence… eh? A failure? Eighty percent of it?!”

“No, sorry, eighty percent was definitely an exaggeration. Probably… looking at it favorably, six… no, around seventy-five percent was…”

“That’s cutting it close…”

For some reason, seeing Emilia become despondent, Subaru felt a pang of conscience and his own shoulders shrank. Seeing Subaru drawn in by her, she frantically waved her hands,

“Ah, but, look, for your first job, twenty percent went well, right? Then it’s fine, I’m sure you can do it well. Here, have confidence.”

“That’s right! Twenty percent on the first try is like a pretty elite batter, isn’t it? Catching the tailwind and getting carried away, I’m gonna get a big head!”

“Don’t be that conceited, reflect properly.”

“Aren’t your demands strict?! Ah, no, it’s nothing, I’m sorry.”

Pushed back by the intensity of Emilia glaring at him with flat eyes, the shoulders that had started to rise hunched and shrank back down as he hung his head.

At any rate,

“Well, truthfully, with Ram and Rem’s backup, it feels like I’m somehow managing. Giving it my all and getting twenty percent can’t be helped anymore, right? So let’s leave that sense of disappointment to future expectations; see you tomorrow.”

“If you yourself don’t mind it like that, then there’s absolutely nothing for me to say, but…”

At Subaru’s forward-looking remark, Emilia pouted her lips as if somewhat sulking. That childish gesture was so abnormally adorable that a chest-tightening sensation made his body run hot.

But, mobilizing all his self-control, he killed that urge.

Subaru made a clownish movement and pointed at her with the fingers of both hands,

“Now, now, now, so for this reason and that reason and all sorts of reasons, today is another day where I diligently live the servant life while being instructed, educated, and punished by the maid sisters. If I get completely exhausted from that life, I’ll dive into Emilia-tan’s lap, so make sure to keep it open.”

“…If I listen to half of what you say, it might feel just right.”

“A harsh evaluation with a cute face! But, but, if you’ll listen to half, that means one knee is okay! Then, Emilia-tan’s one knee for tonight is already reserved by me… so don’t use it without permission, Puck.”

Changing the target he was pointing his finger at, Subaru slammed down a declaration of war. On the other hand, Puck, who was on the receiving end, did not break his composed attitude,

“Heheh, no matter what you say coming in late, Lia has already devoted her body and soul to me through our contract. Given our relationship, it’s too late for you to be sticking your n-nyan nyan nyan

—

”

“Don’t go changing the contract details on your own without me knowing.”

Pinching the ears of the unrepentant Puck, Emilia floated him in the air and shook him.

Since his entire body weight was placed on his ears, one would think it was an unimaginable torture if done to a human, but since the weight of the shaken Puck was basically like fluff to begin with, it didn’t seem to cause any damage. Keeping his usual tranquil expression, he let himself be swayed as he was shaken back and forth.

“Well then, now that I’ve replenished my morning vitality, I guess I’ll go do my work.”

“Replenished vitality? Did you do something?”

“Of course, by flirting with Emilia-tan, my flirt-love power has filled up. Two gauges have filled, so by my calculations, I can fire off two super specials. This is a done deal…”

“There you go getting carried away again. If you only ever tease people like that, when it comes time to tell the truth, no one will believe you. Haven’t you read the fairy tale?”

“I know a similar work, at least! Honestly, I think that’s his own fault so there’s no room to defend him, though.”

“You’re the one saying that, Subaru…?”

At Emilia’s gaze, which seemed to say ‘look at others and correct yourself,’ Subaru stuck out his tongue and stood up with a bashful smile.

Brushing the grass off his rear, he rolled his hips and stretched his back,

“If I don’t get going soon, I’m going to get seriously scolded. This morning I’m scheduled to start with breakfast prep. Emilia-tan, you were bad with green peppers, right? I’ll leave them out for you.”

“Even if I hate them, I still have to eat them… Wait, did I ever talk to you about that, Subaru?”

To Emilia tilting her head in question, Subaru left a small smile and waved his hand.

He was happy that he was able to catch her off guard, even just a tiny bit.

Swaying pointlessly side to side, he played the fool in her field of vision until the very end.

Consciously, consciously, being conscious of making sure his smile did not disappear.

※※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

Seeing off Subaru as he unsteadily disappeared from view, Emilia let out a small sigh and looked at her hands.

At the end of her gaze, the gray kitten was sending his gaze to Subaru’s retreating back. Suddenly noticing Emilia looking down at him, the cat raised his face,

“What’s wrong? You have a gloomy face.”

“I feel kind of, hazy like this. I can’t put it into words well, though.”

Trailing off, Emilia struggled to put the bewilderment inside herself into words. However, it didn’t settle well, and in the end, it merely turned into a silent sigh and vanished into the atmosphere.

Glancing at her conflict, Puck touched his pink nose and narrowed his eyes,

“Are you worried about Subaru? How rare. For Lia to care so much about another person.”

“Don’t just go deciding I’m bad at socializing. I’m not bad at interacting with others, I just haven’t had many opportunities to interact—”

Puffing out her cheeks, she grumbled to the gray cat she had known for a long time.

It was a childish attitude she normally couldn’t take if anyone else were around. Her own way of acting spoiled, which she could only do in front of Puck whom she had known for years, appeared in that attitude.

On the other hand, the expression on Puck who received it was a gentle one.

An attitude like a parent who took joy in their daughter’s growth—from his state of mind, that was exactly what it was, but with that look still on his face, Puck nodded,

“Well, it’s no wonder Lia is confused. Things have become just a little bit troublesome.”

“Troublesome, thing?”

Though leisurely, sensing it was a matter she couldn’t ignore, Emilia’s expression tightened.

Basically, Puck’s attitude remained consistent no matter the situation. Whether this was something unique to spirits, or simply a problem with Puck’s personality, she didn’t know, but there were many cases where the weight of his remarks was left to the judgment of the receiver. Ultimately, it meant Emilia had to judge for herself.

Despite having a serious look directed at him, Puck’s attitude did not break.

Fiddling with the tip of his short whiskers with his fingertips, he said,

“I tried vaguely feeling it, you see. Subaru’s heart, it was waaay messed up. Inside and out, it’s a total, mangled mess. If he stays like that, he might just wear out before too loong, nyaa.”

In an endlessly self-paced tone, he said that.
